State Guides

Public records are kept mostly at the state and county level, and the rules change from state to state. These guides explain how court, business, property, and open records searches work in individual states, which offices to contact, how long agencies have to respond to a records request, and where each state’s official portals and appeals processes are. We add states over time and check each one against official sources.
